title: TSM file
description: A TSM file of a SciMeasure / RedShirt camera, as dev's TSM stack reads one (its macroscope recordings): a FITS-like header with the size (NAXIS1 columns, NAXIS2 rows, NAXIS3 frames), int16 frames and a dark frame, which is subtracted from every frame. Read a chunk at a time; read only.
